info.name: Paypal Subscriptions Authorizations Trackers API
info.description: You can use billing plans and subscriptions to create subscriptions that process recurring PayPal payments for physical or digital goods, or services. A plan includes pricing and billing cycle information that defines the amount and frequency of charge for a subscription. You can also define a fixed plan, such as a $5 basic plan or a volume- or graduated-based plan with pricing tiers based on the quantity purchased. For more information, see Subscriptions Overview.

item.name: Update or cancel tracking information for a PayPal order

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the order that the tracking information is associated with.

request.description:
Updates or cancels the tracking information for a PayPal order, by ID. Updatable attributes or objects:

AttributeOpNotes
itemsreplaceUsing replace op for items will replace the entire items object with the value sent in request.
notify_payerreplace, add
statusreplaceOnly patching status to CANCELLED is currently supported.

item.name: Update or cancel tracking information for PayPal transaction

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the tracker in the transaction_id-tracking_number format.

request.description: Updates or cancels the tracking information for a PayPal transaction, by ID. To cancel tracking information, call this method and set the status to CANCELLED. For more information, see Update or cancel tracking information.

response.name: A successful request returns the HTTP 204 OK status code with no JSON response body.
